title: 3D Component Hover Select and Edge Preview
description: Fix vertex/edge/face hover and selection in WGPU world engine and lowpoly plugin; add Show Edges window option toggle.
summary: Fixed 3D hover/selection not appearing after pick commands. Root cause: renderer-local World3dState only updated on next plugin round-trip via sync_world3d_state, so overlays and instance flags lagged or never showed until JSON changed. Added apply_world_command_preview() to apply setHover/worldPick/worldSelect/worldHover payloads immediately before async dispatch; wired into WGPU dispatch_commands. Component hover now updates local state optimistically in pick_hover_command. Mesh-mode clicks now route through worldPick (not worldSelect) so lowpoly fixture.selection.ids drives selection. world_instances_json derives selected/hovered from fixture selection and hovered_target (removed always-selected active object). worldPick with null id clears selection. React host clears selection on background click. Fixed ui_wgpu input.rs on_button clone for WASM build. Tests: apply_world_command_preview, world_pick_null_clears_selection; updated mesh click test to expect worldPick. Rebuilt WGPU WASM renderer.
